evo_title: A foundation model of transcription across human cell types
har_title: Transcriptomic Maps of Colorectal Liver Metastasis: Machine Learning of Gene Activation Patterns and Epigenetic Trajectories in Support of Precision Medicine
evo_topic: Transformer predicting gene expression from sequence + chromatin accessibility across 213 cell types.
har_topic: Trajectory inference ordering colorectal liver-metastasis subtypes along a pseudotime tree.
mismatched_roles: TRANSITION, SEARCH, FEEDBACK (absent in GET); OBJECTIVE (absent in GET)
why: GET is a static sequence-to-expression regression: it has no operator moving a state, no trajectory rule, no feedback. Filling T or π for GET would require calling 'unseen cell type' a transition, which is a re-description.

evo_title: Zero-shot prediction of mutation effects with multimodal deep representation learning guides protein engineering
har_title: Data integration and inference of gene regulation using single-cell temporal multimodal data with scTIE
evo_topic: Multimodal protein representation scoring mutation effects zero-shot (ProMEP).
har_topic: Autoencoder + iterative optimal transport integrating temporal multiome data to predict cell trajectories (scTIE).
mismatched_roles: OBJECTIVE (likelihood over sequences vs transport cost between time points), SEARCH (none vs trajectory prediction)
why: Both learn an embedding, so REPRESENTATION matches. The scalar in ProMEP scores states; the scalar in scTIE is a transport cost between distributions, not a potential over states, and ProMEP has no trajectory rule. Level 1 plus one slot.

evo_title: Evolutionary velocity with protein language models predicts evolutionary dynamics of diverse proteins
har_title: Regulation of prophage induction and lysogenization by phage communication systems
evo_topic: PLM-derived vector field over sequence space predicting direction of protein evolution.
har_topic: Analytical model of optimal lysis/lysogeny plasticity under fluctuating host density, tested in B. subtilis phage phi3T.
mismatched_roles: OBJECTIVE (none vs fitness of a plasticity strategy), FEEDBACK (none vs environmental signal)
why: Evo-velocity is descriptive: a flow read off likelihoods, with no objective and no environment. The phage model optimises a strategy against an environmental signal. Caveat: the phage paper is itself an evolutionary-fitness model, so the pair shares a domain even though its computations differ.

evo_title: Rapid directed evolution guided by protein language models and epistatic interactions
har_title: Engineering repressors with coevolutionary cues facilitates toggle switches with a master reset
evo_topic: PLM + epistasis model proposes multimutants; one round of ML-guided directed evolution (MULTI-evolve).
har_topic: Coevolution statistics among LacI homologs predict compatible domain fusions; engineered repressors build toggle switches.
slots_fillable_both_sides: STATE, REPRESENTATION, OBJECTIVE, TRANSITION, SEARCH, FEEDBACK
why: Both: sequence/domain state; evolutionary-statistics representation (PLM vs coevolution); predicted function as objective; variant proposal (mutation vs domain fusion); experimental selection. The lexicon misses 'fusion', 'compatibility', 'design' as roles. Reported as a false negative, not a control.
